name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 10.5. Adds two features: (1) new 'Is one of' / 'Is not one of' filter operators across both Query Builders, producing SQL IN (...) / NOT IN (...) clauses from a comma-separated list of values (supported in manual filter rows and in the plain-language description parser); (2) explicit 'Publish to the Shared Schema Location' and 'Delete from the Shared Schema Location' actions, added directly inside the Smart Schema Import Engine's Preview Changes card and the Danger Zone's Delete Current Schema flow respectively, both powered by the existing GitHub-Hosted Schema Sync (Option B) connection — genuinely committing to, or deleting from (via GitHub's DELETE Contents API), the exact file that the Live Shared Schema auto-loader (V10.4) reads on every device and browser. Every existing feature from V10.4 and earlier continues to work exactly as before.
